errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart with five groups of two bars each (one for each year). The description incorrectly states that it contains two groups of bars, which misrepresents the structure.

The description does not clarify that the chart is effectively a dual-axis chart. It describes the Y-axis for the number of cars (blue bars) but fails to mention that this scale does not apply to the percentage values (orange bars), which use their own scale (indicated by data labels).
The description fails to mention the placeholder text 'Axis Title' under the x-axis labels.
